subject: FastGift pre-launch: rate cap & temporary capacity request
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@fastgift.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pre-launch request: temporary rate bump for July 26 campaign

Hi Ben,

We are ramping a paid acquisition push on July 26 and expect a sharp spike in inference traffic for one 72-hour window. We ran an internal model and attached the spec and a traffic model. Headline numbers: peak concurrent sessions ~9-11k, expected peak sustained QPS 2.5k for 2 hours, average payload ~620 tokens in and ~150 tokens out.

Ask: Can Redwood temporarily increase our hosted API per-minute token and concurrency quotas for the 26th through the 28th? We also want guidance on recommended soft rate limits, canary routing, and whether you suggest short-term Dedicated for the window.

We are happy to sign a short-term commitment if that simplifies provisioning. Can we schedule a 30-minute pre-launch run-through this week?

Attachments: fastgift_campaign_spec.pdf, fastgift_initial_traffic_model.xlsx

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Head of Product, FastGift
elaine@fastgift.com
Onboarding contact: ops@fastgift.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pre-launch request: temporary rate bump for July 26 campaign

Team, forwarding FastGift's ask. TLDR: 3-day spike starting 2027-07-26, peak concurrent ~10k, peak QPS ~2.5k for a couple hours, average request tokens ~770 total. They are open to a short-term commitment.

Immediate asks:
- Karthik: can you confirm if hosted capacity can be scaled to absorb a 2.5k QPS burst without impacting other customers, and what the target token rate limit should be per-minute?
- Laura/Marissa: CS/AM side, we should propose a mutual action plan and a minimal committed throughput to justify any reserved capacity. Also need to line up billing/credits if we offer a temporary SLA exception.
- Evelyn: leadership/ops oversight. We may need a short SLA exception for rate caps and an ops runbook for emergency rollback.

Propose we hold a 30-minute call Wed 10:00 PT to align and then run a small canary on the 25th. I can coordinate with Elaine for availability.

Ben
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pre-launch request: temporary rate bump for July 26 campaign

Thanks Ben. Quick technical read: based on their numbers (avg payload ~770 tokens), 2.5k QPS equates to ~1.9M tokens/sec which is not feasible on hosted shared pools without impacting tail latency. Options and rough numbers:

1) Short-term Dedicated reservation (recommended): reserve 8-12 A100-equivalent cards for the 72-hour window. That gets us predictable latency and keeps other customers isolated. Estimated cost footprint documented in the draft runbook.
2) Hosted capacity + strict soft-rate limits: we can support ~400-500 QPS burst in shared hosted with aggressive batching and prefix caching; for their 2.5k QPS we would need aggressive throttles and a canary strategy to progressively increase.
3) Hybrid: route 20% of traffic to Dedicated (if they commit) and the rest through hosted with staged ramp. This reduces immediate footprint and gives fallbacks.

Recommended immediate config if customer wants fastest path: a temporary Dedicated reservation for the 26-28 window plus a hard soft-limit on hosted routes at 600 QPS and a per-minute token cap of 90M tokens/minute while Dedicated handles peaks. Also: require a canary at 10% traffic on 25th and a final production ramp plan with circuit breaker thresholds at 5xx rate and latency 95th p95 guardrails.

I will attach an internal capacity calc separately to the ops channel. Need confirmation on whether finance will approve a week-ahead short-term billing commitment.

- Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pre-launch request: temporary rate bump for July 26 campaign

Agree with Karthik. From CS/account side, we should capture: committed windows, escalation contacts, mutual action plan milestones, and a short amendment to their MSA for the temporary Dedicated reservation. If FastGift signs a 3-day commitment, we can lock capacity. Otherwise we risk last-minute allocation issues.

Suggested next steps:
- Ben: request that FastGift confirms the committed spend for the window and signs this short amendment (I can draft).
- Laura: prepare the runbook for the canary and rollback procedures and make sure OnCall is staffed for the 26th.
- Karthik: prepare the minimal infra config & test instructions.

I will also prepare a one-page plan for the customer that shows options and costs so they can make a quick decision.

Marissa
Customer Success Manager

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@fastgift.com>, FastGift Ops <ops@fastgift.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-launch request: temporary rate bump for July 26 campaign

Elaine — thanks for sending the model. Quick update from our side after internal alignment:

1) We can support your peak reliably if FastGift signs a 72-hour Dedicated reservation for the July 26 00:00 - July 28 23:59 PST window. Estimated committed spend and options are in the attached one-pager (I have attached the CS one-pager we discussed).
2) If you prefer no commitment, we can run a hosted canary with a staged ramp but must cap hosted soft-rate limits to 600 QPS to protect other customers. In that scenario we will provide active monitoring and an ops playbook but cannot guarantee Dedicated-level latency during the peak.
3) Required pre-launch: a canary at 10% traffic on July 25 and a signed short amendment by July 24 17:00 PT to guarantee Dedicated provisioning.

Proposed calendar: 30-minute alignment call Friday 10:00 PT. Please confirm availability and which path you prefer (Dedicated reservation vs hosted canary). When you confirm, Marissa will send the amendment and I will schedule the runbook review with Karthik.

Attachments: fastgift_campaign_spec.pdf, fastgift_initial_traffic_model.xlsx, fastgift_cs_onepager.pdf

Thanks,
Ben
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
